quests.transport.subtitle: What ever happened to walking on your own two feet?
quests.transport.steel_main.title: Steel Age
quests.transport.mv_main.title: &bMV&r
quests.transport.ev_main.title: &5EV&r
quests.tfg_tips.glider.title: Hang Glider
quests.tfg_tips.glider.subtitle: This is not Breath of the Wild
quests.tfg_tips.glider.desc:
A &dHang Glider&r can be used to glide along the air. You &ccannot gain altitude&r with this but it can be useful to traverse long distances if you jump from high up.
Great synergy with &bJetpacks&r though!
quests.tfg_tips.reinforced_glider.title: Reinforced Glider
quests.tfg_tips.reinforced_glider.desc:
A &dReinforced Hang Glider&r is the improved version of a &aHang Glider&r. With an upgraded &aAluminium&r frame and a fabric made of either &aReinforced Fabric&r or &aLightweight Cloth&r, you can now soar through the skies at &cdouble the speed&r!
It also has &cmore durability&r than the normal hang glider, and can be &crepaired&r in an assembler.

&3Pro tip:&r
Using either &aSilk Cloth&r or &aPhantom Silk&r obtained in &4The Beneath&r reduces the fabric cost by &e2/3rds&r for both crafting and repairing!
Once you enter &6HV&r, you can also use &aPolycaprolactam Fabric&r as one of the fabrics with a reduced cost.
quests.tfg_tips.warfare.title: Sea Warfare
quests.tfg_tips.warfare.subtitle: FIRE ALL CANNONS!
quests.tfg_tips.warfare.desc:
You can outfit your &bSloop&r with firepower via the &dCannon&r and cannon balls, in case you want to blow something to smithereens.
To fire a cannon, you'll need to load it with some &aGunpowder&r, &aUnrefined Paper&r and your &aCannon Ball&r. Then light the wick with &cFlint and Steel.&r

Don't have a &bSloop&r? Don't worry! Cannons can be placed and fired on the ground the same way you would fire one on a &bSloop&r.
quests.tfg_tips.kayak_materials.title: The Kayak
quests.tfg_tips.kayak_materials.subtitle: Get yourself that Kayak.
quests.tfg_tips.kayak_materials.desc: The &dKayak&r is the second most simple boat you can craft, requiring &bWaxes&r for the &aWaterproof Hides&r. It is also the &conly&r boat that can be picked up as an item. Despite having a &dsingle passenger&r slot, it is the fastest boat in the game until the iron age &dSloop!&r
quests.tfg_tips.create_canoe.title: The Canoe
quests.tfg_tips.create_canoe.subtitle: Happy Canoe-ing!
quests.tfg_tips.create_canoe.desc:
With the &dCanoe&r, traversing bodies of water in the early game will now be possible. Make sure you create a &bCanoe Paddle&r so you can go faster!

To complete the first task of this quest, you need to look at the finished &dCanoe.&r

&3&lTip:&r&o Two players, both equipped with paddles, can achieve a higher top speed together in the same canoe. Multiplayer only of course!
quests.tfg_tips.create_rowboat.title: The Rowboat
quests.tfg_tips.create_rowboat.subtitle: Happy Rowboat-ing!
quests.tfg_tips.create_rowboat.desc:
With the &dRowboat&r, you can now transport a decent amount of items across the oceans, perfect for overseas exploration, perhaps to the tropics! Make sure you create two &bOars&r so you can go faster!
You can also dye it!

To complete the first task of this quest, you need to look at any finished &dRowboat.&r

&3&lTips:&r&o Two passenger slots? Perfect for bringing home pairs of breeding animals for your farm through a river system or across lakes and oceans.
quests.tfg_tips.sloop_under_construction: The Great Pirate Era has begun

The &dSloop&r is the most advanced seaworthy vessel, requiring &aWrought Iron.&r It has ample space for storage, anvils and workbenches! It is incredibly expensive and requires practice to sail, but makes traveling over huge oceans a breeze. Finish it off with a paint job when you're finished, by right-clicking the hull or sails with dye.

The &2Field Guide&r has all the details for construction and on how to sail.

Remember that the entire boat needs to be constructed from the same wood type, so make sure you have plenty before starting!
quests.tfg_tips.astikorcarts.title: TFC Astikor Carts
quests.tfg_tips.astikorcarts.subtitle: Overland routes
quests.tfg_tips.astikorcarts.desc:
&2TFC Astikor Carts&r provide early game transport options for land travel for both mobs and items.
Carts can be manually pulled by &cplayers&r (very slow if they are full!) or by &bequine animals&r, such as horses.

Remember to use the &4"Action Key" keybind (default R)&r to attach or de-attach yourself or the animal you are riding to the cart.
quests.tfg_tips.horseshoes.title: Horseshoes
quests.tfg_tips.horseshoes.subtitle: Fashionable Equine Footwear
quests.tfg_tips.horseshoes.desc: &aHorseshoes&r are an accessory for your equine companions that boost their &9speed&r, &dfall resistance&r, and &cstep height&r at higher tiers.
quests.tfg_tips.hiking_boots.title: Hiking Boots
quests.tfg_tips.hiking_boots.subtitle: 🎵 and I would walk five hundred miles
quests.tfg_tips.hiking_boots.desc: &aHiking Boots&r prevent tall grass from slowing you down, increase your safe fall height, and can even give you some extra step height and walking speed. They don't provide as much protection as proper metal armor, but if you're not actually fighting something, these are well worth the trade-off!
quests.tfg_tips.firmaciv_info.title: Voyage Gadgets
quests.tfg_tips.firmaciv_info.subtitle: In case you care for realism
quests.tfg_tips.firmaciv_info.desc:
&3Firma:Civ&r comes with 4 different navigational tools, each giving you important information about your position in the world.
Includes the &dSextant&r, &dNavigator's Timepiece&r, &dBarometer&r, and &dCompass&r; more information about the tools in the &2Field Guide.&r

&l&3&oLore:&r&o Firma:Civ by default removes coordinates to make you use its navigational tools. TFG has that disabled by default, but you can re-enable it in its configs if you'd like.
quests.tfg_tips.equines.title: Horse Riding
quests.tfg_tips.equines.subtitle: Stallion of the Cimarron
quests.tfg_tips.equines.desc:
Find yourself either a &bHorse&r, &bDonkey&r, or &bCamel&r and build up enough &afamiliarity&r to let them ride you with your trusty &aSaddle&r, knapped from leather.
In addition, they can pull &dCarts&r without speed penalties!

&bHorses&r are great for exploring the interior of continents effortlessly in the early game, and can be bred for better stats.

&bDonkeys&r and &bMules&r can carry an extra chest or even a barrel without a &2Supply Cart&r, while &bCamels&r can carry two players, walk faster on sand, and have a long jump.

As always, more information (such as spawning conditions) is in the &2Field Guide.&r

&3&lTip:&r&o Want to horse-ride on a different continent across the ocean? Don't worry, you can bring along your trusty ride on certain boats!
quests.tfg_tips.supply_cart.title: Supply Cart
quests.tfg_tips.supply_cart.subtitle: Carry All
quests.tfg_tips.supply_cart.desc:
With a whopping &c54&r slots, &dSupply Carts&r can carry a large amount of items &aregardless of their weight&r, even anvils!
Perfect for exploration, mining and logging trips, or for moving bases!
quests.tfg_tips.animal_cart.title: Animal Cart
quests.tfg_tips.animal_cart.subtitle: Animal Kidnapper Machine
quests.tfg_tips.animal_cart.desc:
The &dAnimal Cart&r allows you transport up to 3 animals across land.
Perfect for collecting breeding pairs for your livestock farms! Simply run over an animal with the cart. &cShift-right click&r to dismount all animals.
quests.tfg_tips.plow.title: Plow
quests.tfg_tips.plow.subtitle: Large Scale Farming
quests.tfg_tips.plow.desc: If there ever comes the need to till large sections of land for some megafarms, the &dPlow&r can come in clutch.
quests.transport.airship.subtitle: How's the weather up there?
quests.transport.airship.desc:
The Airship is the first proper form of flight you have access to. While it's accessible with Wrought Iron, it will also cost a lot of &dcloth&r, so hopefully you've been working on growing some Flax, Jute, or Cotton, or raising some wooly animals.

The Airship is slower than traveling on horseback or boat, but has no other limitations like needing to cross rivers or only being limited to water.

You can fuel it with any burnable solid fuel, such as charcoal.

&cNote: This airship will be replaced with one from Immersive Vehicles later.&r
quests.transport.immersive_vehicles.desc:
Welcome to &6Immersive Vehicles&r! This mod has a very in-depth modular system for driving, piloting, customizing, and building all sorts of vehicles, but it can be a lot to take in at once.

Read the &eField Guide&r with the link below to get your drivers' license and learn everything about how vehicles work!
quests.transport.boilerbox.subtitle: Honk honk, the circus has arrived
quests.transport.boilerbox.desc:
The &6Boilerbox&r is your first road vehicle! It comes with a wide variety of upgrades. Normally it only fits one passenger, but you can upgrade it to fit two.

You can fuel it with Lava, any kind of Oil (cooking oils and petro oils both work), Creosote, and Biomass. Note that creosote and biomass are a bit weaker than the others.
quests.transport.biplane.subtitle: Is it a bird? No, it's a plane!
quests.transport.biplane.desc:
The &6Biplane&r is your first proper airplane! It comes with a wide variety of upgrades. Normally it only fits one passenger, but you can upgrade it to fit two.

You can fuel it with Lava, any kind of Oil (cooking oils and petro oils both work), Creosote, and Biomass. Note that creosote and biomass are a bit weaker than the others.
quests.transport.workshop.subtitle: All-purpose garage
quests.transport.workshop.desc:
From here on, all vehicles must be created in the &eAutomotive Workshop&r. This multiblock allows for a large number of item and fluid inputs. Be sure to check the &6Field Guide&r on how to pour the concrete.

As a lot of vehicles have overlapping colors for their dyes, be sure you set the appropriate circuit number in an Input Bus.
quests.transport.universal_fuel.title: Universal Vehicle Fuel
quests.transport.universal_fuel.subtitle: Leaded or Unleaded?
quests.transport.universal_fuel.desc:
&eUniversal Vehicle Fuel&r is, well, a fuel that every vehicle accepts. Check EMI for the fuels you can brew into it. Stronger GregTech fuels will brew into more universal vehicle fuel.

&l&3&oLore:&r Vehicles are normally split into categories such as 'gasoline', 'diesel', and so on, but because Gasoline isn't obtainable until &6HV&r, it would effectively block half of the available vehicles until then. Universal Fuel is the compromise, though you can still use the GregTech fuels if you insist on realism.
quests.transport.quad.title: Quadbikes
quests.transport.quad.subtitle: On road! Off road! No road!
quests.transport.quad.desc: The Quadbike is a relatively cheap vehicle that's ready to drive as soon as it's finished crafting. It has great step height and is the perfect choice for traveling to new places off-road.
quests.transport.silver.title: Silver Motorbikes
quests.transport.silver.subtitle: Leather jacket not included
quests.transport.silver.desc: The Silver Motorbike is a relatively cheap vehicle if you don't want to splurge on anything bigger. Its simplicity also means no upgrades or cargo capacity, unfortunately.
quests.transport.scout.title: Scout SUVs
quests.transport.scout.subtitle: Practical and flexible
quests.transport.scout.desc: The Scout is a reliable SUV with a lot of potential. You can fill the back with a load of cargo, two more seats, or if you take the pickup bed off, even a gun turret!
quests.transport.brotchen.title: Brotchen Cars
quests.transport.brotchen.subtitle: The perfect budget car for getting stuck in traffic.
quests.transport.brotchen.desc: Looking for something more straightforward? The Brotchen cars do exactly what they say on the tin.
quests.transport.bullfrog.title: Bullfrog Cars
quests.transport.bullfrog.subtitle: Compensating for something?
quests.transport.bullfrog.desc: The Bullfrog is a muscle car. They're a bit more expensive than a Brotchen, but can go faster.
quests.transport.gmcbrig.title: Brigadier Trucks
quests.transport.gmcbrig.subtitle: Who needs trains anyway!
quests.transport.gmcbrig.desc: Want to transport a load of stuff without having to place down an entire railway? The Brigadier is a customizable truck with a variety of different trailers, ranging from items, to fluids, to even passengers.
quests.transport.fisker.title: Fisker Boats
quests.transport.fisker.subtitle: Gone Fishin'
quests.transport.fisker.desc: Tired of your rowboat? Never learnt how to sail? The Fisker is a small fishing boat that's still very capable of travling across oceans without breaking your back.
quests.transport.pzlp11.title: PZL P11.c Aircraft
quests.transport.pzlp11.subtitle: War... war never changes
quests.transport.pzlp11.desc: The PZL P11.c is a fast propellor plane that can also be equipped with a machine gun. It can only hold one passenger.
quests.transport.pzl37b.title: PZL.37B Los Aircraft
quests.transport.pzl37b.subtitle: Starting arguments on internet forums since 1938
quests.transport.pzl37b.desc: The PZL.37B Los is a larger bomber plane, capable of being equipped with multiple guns and bomb crates. It can hold up to four passengers.
quests.transport.bell47g.title: Bell 47G Helicopter
quests.transport.bell47g.subtitle: Let's hope you aren't in the opening scene of an action movie
quests.transport.bell47g.desc:
The Bell 47G is a lightweight helicopter that can fit up to two passengers. Helicopters are perfect if you want to fly places with unknown terrain, so you can lift off and land without needing a runway.

It can also be equipped with guns and a rocket launcher, if you're into that sort of thing.
quests.transport.adventure.title: Adventure Vans
quests.transport.adventure.subtitle: Adventure Time
quests.transport.adventure.desc: The Adventure Van can hold up to eight passengers, a load of cargo, and you can even attach a trailer to pull around a boat! Perfect for going on a camping trip with your whole server.
quests.transport.keeper.title: Keeper SUVs
quests.transport.keeper.subtitle: Those animals are so funny they make me wanna merge without looking!
quests.transport.keeper.desc: The Keeper SUV can only hold two passengers but can carry a lot of cargo, and you can even attach a trailer to pull around a boat!
quests.transport.fire_truck.subtitle: What starts with F and ends with U-C-K?
quests.transport.fire_truck.desc: Has your neighbour decided to build their new smithy out of wood and thatch? Pull up to their base and blast them (and their building) with the water cannon on this fire truck!
quests.transport.paragon.title: Paragon Buses
quests.transport.paragon.subtitle: Don't forget to thank your bus driver!
quests.transport.paragon.desc: Let's be honest, you're not gonna be making this unless you're on a large server and helping run a big event. But if that's you, then this bus can fit 15, including the driver!
quests.transport.citadel.title: Citadel Trucks
quests.transport.citadel.subtitle: As Seen in Trucker Life Magazine
quests.transport.citadel.desc: This behemoth of the road can pull trailers of cargo, fluids, and even other cars or smaller trucks!
quests.transport.corallum.title: Corallum Boats
quests.transport.corallum.subtitle: Gone Whalin'
quests.transport.corallum.desc: Not only is the Corallum faster than the Fisker, but it can also hold up to 9 passengers or crates!
quests.transport.trimotor.title: Trimotor Aircraft
quests.transport.trimotor.subtitle: Sky Whales are real!
quests.transport.trimotor.desc: The biggest plane in the modpack, the Trimotor is perfect for hauling around a ton of cargo and/or passengers (up to 16). Just be sure your runway is long enough!
quests.transport.bell206.title: Bell 206 Helicopters
quests.transport.bell206.subtitle: Get to the choppa!
quests.transport.bell206.desc: The Bell 206 is an upgraded helicopter that can also carry up to 5 passengers, a bunch of cargo, and can even be equipped with a searchlight or hoist for rescuing people who forgot to bring ladders to their copper mine.
quests.transport.comanche.title: Comanche Aircraft
quests.transport.comanche.subtitle: Reach for the skies!
quests.transport.comanche.desc: The Comanche is a small and fast prop plane that can fit four passengers and some of their cargo. However, because of the lower wings, it might struggle to lift off on rough terrain.
quests.transport.skyhawk.title: Skyhawk Aircraft
quests.transport.skyhawk.subtitle: Fly like an eagle
quests.transport.skyhawk.desc: The Skyhawk is an easy to fly prop plane that can fit four passengers and some of their cargo. It's not &oquite&r as fast as the Comanche, but it can handle bumpy runways more easily.
quests.transport.mercedes.title: Mercedes Cars
quests.transport.mercedes.subtitle: Did you know each E is pronounced differently?
quests.transport.mercedes.desc: Of the two cars available in &6HV&r, the Mercedes is slightly more focused on utility instead of speed. That being said, it's still significantly faster than the earlier cars, so it can be well worth making.
quests.transport.mustang.title: Mustang Cars
quests.transport.mustang.subtitle: Microplastics last 500 years but a Mercedes lasts forever
quests.transport.mustang.desc: If you want to set land speed records against your friends or just get from point A to point B faster, the Mustang is the pinnacle of fast cars.
quests.space_survival.rover.title: Space Rover
quests.space_survival.rover.subtitle: Your getaway vehicle
quests.space_survival.rover.desc:
You had to leave your fancy jetpack at home, there's no atmosphere for normal airplanes or cars, and horses can't survive, so how are you supposed to get around?

The &bRover&r is a space-capable vehicle that can hold up to two passengers, can run on normal vehicle fuel as well as Rocket Fuel, and even has an inventory and radio that can play real-world radio stations!
quests.transport.starfish.title: Starfish Boats
quests.transport.starfish.subtitle: Gone Jetskiing
quests.transport.starfish.desc: Show those losers in the rowboats who's boss with this fast boat that's also capable of carrying seven passengers.
quests.transport.vulcanair.title: Vulcanair Aircraft
quests.transport.vulcanair.subtitle: What's the deal with airline food?
quests.transport.vulcanair.desc:
The vulcanair can take six passengers along on a fast, easy to pilot ride anywhere in the world!

If you're a fan of taking photos, this plane also comes with a camera so you can keep an eye on what your neighbour is up to.
quests.transport.e500.title: Eclipse e500 Aircraft
quests.transport.e500.subtitle: Jet Fuel can't melt Steel Mining Supports
quests.transport.e500.desc: The Eclipse is TFG's only jet plane, capable of carrying six passengers. Perfect for any modern airport or if you just wanna show off!
quests.space_survival.soarer.title: Soarer
quests.space_survival.soarer.subtitle: Need a lift?
quests.space_survival.soarer.desc:
Airplanes don't work on Mars, and your space suit doesn't have a jetpack, so there's no other way to fly, right?

If you're able to find an elusive &4Soarer&r, you can tame them with Raw Fish and equip them with a Saddle to glide through the Martian skies with ease.

They can't fly forever though, indicated by the wing icons on the top left, and will need to land occasionally. (You can feed them more Raw Fish to speed up their recovery.)

Still, they're a great option for long-distance travel, and won't upset the sandworm either!

&9Note&r: Soarers are unable to survive on particularly hot planets such as &6Venus&r.
quests.space_survival.surfer.title: Surfer
quests.space_survival.surfer.subtitle: Need a swim?
quests.space_survival.surfer.desc:
&bSurfers&r can be found in the small bodies of water on Mars. You can tame them by sneaking up to them while they're lying on the shore, and feeding them raw fish. Once tamed, you can equip them with a saddle to swim quickly underwater too.

This doesn't sound particularly useful on Mars, but remember that you can transport entities around through AE2's Spatial Storage Disks, and there will be a certain oceanic icy moon in the future...

&9Note&r: Surfers are unable to survive on particularly hot planets such as &6Venus&r.
quests.space_survival.charger.title: Charger
quests.space_survival.charger.subtitle: Chaaaaaaaaarge!
quests.space_survival.charger.desc:
&bChargers&r are large green herbivores that can be found roaming around on Mars. You can tame them with any Martian crop, but don't feed them &cBeetroot&r...

Once tamed, you can equip them with a saddle and Armor for some extra defence, hold down Spacebar to charge forward in a straight line (dealing extra damage and knockback), or press the &eSpecial Ability&r keybind (default &9C&r) for a headbutt attack.

Feeding them more Martian crops will restore their health.

&9Note&r: Chargers are unable to survive on particularly hot planets such as &6Venus&r.
quests.space_survival.walker.title: Walker
quests.space_survival.walker.subtitle: Martian Truck
quests.space_survival.walker.desc:
Traveled a bit on Mars and want to move your base, or just want to travel around on a collosal mount with your friends? The &bWalker&r is a huge herbivore you can tame with any Martian crop, and when tamed, you can equip them with a saddle and chest to carry up to four passengers and their cargo.

&9Note&r: Walkers are unable to survive on particularly hot planets such as &6Venus&r.
quests.transport.platerodrilus.title: Platerodrilus
quests.transport.platerodrilus.subtitle: Oversized woodlouse
quests.transport.platerodrilus.desc:
Tired of running away screaming from all the yucky mean bugs on Venus? The Platerodrilus can be tamed with &bVenus Cacti&r and then ridden like other mounts, moving at a fast speed with a strong jump!

Feeding them more cacti will restore their health.

&9Note&r: Platerodrilus are unable to survive on particularly cold planets such as &cMars&r.
quests.transport.ancient_beetle.title: Titan Horned Beetle
quests.transport.ancient_beetle.subtitle: Don't get caught in the rain!
quests.transport.ancient_beetle.desc:
It might be difficult to find one of these massive beetles, but when you do, try to tame them with &bVenus Cacti&r. Raise their familiarity to equip them with a saddle, letting you ride them high into the air. 

While they move slower than the Platerodrilus, being able to fly above most of Venus' nasties is well worth it. If you decide to fight anyway, the beetle has a barrel roll charge attack that you can activate with &9C&r.

Feeding them more cacti will restore their health.

&9Note&r: Horned Beetles are unable to survive on particularly cold planets such as &cMars&r.
